metadata.description: Das 32. Wirtschafts- und Umweltforum befasst sich mit der Frage, wie die Antizipation technologischer Entwicklungen und die Stärkung einer wissenschaftsbasierten Diplomatie zu Sicherheit und Stabilität im gesamten OSZE-Raum beitragen können. Ziel ist es, die Teilnehmerstaaten dabei zu unterstützen, sich besser auf aktuelle und neue Herausforderungen vorzubereiten.

metadata.description: The 32nd Economic and Environmental Forum focuses on how the anticipation of technological developments and the strengthening of science-based diplomacy can contribute to security and stability across the OSCE area. The aim is to support participating States in better preparing for current and emerging challenges.

en.description: The 32nd Economic and Environmental Forum focuses on how the anticipation of technological developments and the strengthening of science-based diplomacy can contribute to security and stability across the OSCE area. The aim is to support participating States in better preparing for current and emerging challenges.
text: The OSCE has published a press release for the two-day 32nd Economic and Environmental Forum in Prague, organized by the Office of the Co-ordinator of OSCE Economic and Environmental Activities under the leadership of the 2026 Swiss OSCE Chairpersonship.
The press release is available at the following link:
en.title: OSCE press release: OSCE opens 32nd Economic and Environmental Forum in Prague

metadata.description: Le 32e Forum économique et environnemental est consacré à la manière dont l'anticipation des évolutions technologiques et le renforcement d'une diplomatie fondée sur la science peuvent contribuer à la sécurité et à la stabilité dans l'ensemble de l'espace de l'OSCE. L’objectif est de soutenir les États participants à mieux se préparer aux défis actuels et émergents.

metadata.description: Il 32° Forum economico e ambientale è dedicato al modo in cui l’anticipazione degli sviluppi tecnologici e il rafforzamento di una diplomazia basata sulla scienza possono contribuire alla sicurezza e alla stabilità nell’intera area dell’OSCE. L’obiettivo è sostenere gli Stati partecipanti affinché possano prepararsi meglio alle sfide attuali ed emergenti.
